description: Measures PCIe transfer bandwidth between host and device in three modes: unidirectional H2D, unidirectional D2H, and bidirectional (concurrent H2D+D2H on two streams). Uses pinned host memory for maximum throughput. Emits per-iteration GPU event time and host time records (total = sum of transfer times); GB/s is derived downstream.

scaling_param.name: buffer_size_mb
scaling_param.description: Transfer buffer size in MiB per direction; controls total data volume

non_scaling_params.name: transfer_type
non_scaling_params.description: Transfer mode: unidirectional H2D, D2H, or bidirectional

non_scaling_params.name: use_pinned_memory
non_scaling_params.description: Whether to use pinned (page-locked) host memory for transfers
